reviews.text:
We were received very kindly, and our animals were cared for with love. The veterinarian was also flexible in finding ways to make the transport of the animals faster and different, as they were very stressed. We really appreciated that.

Initially, the first check-up and the procedure could not take place in a single appointment. Fortunately, it later turned out to be possible after all. That was very nice, although we did not quite understand why this was not possible at first. The care and involvement were very pleasant, but we found the price to be extremely high.
I got some paperwork done for my dog to travel. They were very friendly.

Excellent!

Thank you for taking care of my cat.

Thank you very much!

Obrigado!

We received wonderful help; we were allowed to come in the very same day. The female veterinarian was very sweet and caring towards our dog.

The staff at the reception desk were also very friendly.

I never leave reviews, but the service here is very disappointing. After spending a lot of money here for years, I was 8 minutes late today because all trams are being diverted due to renovations on the Rozengracht. I ran from Leidseplein with two children and a dog, so I was 8 minutes late. The journey had taken me an hour. After explaining the situation, I was told to turn around and make a new appointment. Furthermore, there was no one else waiting in the waiting area. It is scandalous to treat a regular customer with a valid reason, who went to so much trouble to arrive on time, like this. I will not be coming back here. They are also terribly expensive, by the way.

Unprofessional the worst in Amsterdam for sure. I went there for my ferret that was hurt. The nurse didn't have disinfectant liquid , i repeat she didn't have disinfectant.  So she used water from the tap to clean her wound ( for me was ok because I know that healthy ferrets have enough anticorps to combat a little infection) the annoying part is that the nurse she thought she was talkin to a dumb person , because she was bragging that: (cit.)"the water in Amsterdam is so clean that you can use it to disinfect wounds" .
And they are also very expensive.
Great friendly staff
After a referral to the veterinary clinic/hospital, it cost a month's salary, but my cat is better again!
Very nice vet who takes good care of Moos and is always very clear and friendly towards us as well

It's a shame I can only give 5 stars. I'd love to give 10. Cynthia is my hero! She was so kind to my cat Grey, who really became the most aggressive version of himself there. She cared for him with so much love after having nine teeth removed. The care she gave me as an owner was just pure love. She explained everything beforehand and, after the surgery, she was very well-informed about what had happened.
Your cat is truly in good hands here.

My cat hadn't improved after a blood test and a failed x-ray, but I was €500 poorer.
At another practice, it turned out to be just a flea allergy.
They're too focused on making money. I won't be going back.

They are really nice and professional, the Vet did a full check to my cat, new NL pet passport, nails cut and an anti rabies vaccination, they are so friendly with pets and they giving good advice for pet health and any questions related too

Five stars is far too few, I give it a big 10 for all the help, dedication, and patience 😉 over the past few years with my cat Kiwi. I wouldn't know how I would have managed without you. Three years of intensive care for a sugar cat, nothing was too much (and Kiwi was sometimes a lot). I'm so glad he got to share his last years with you. I'm sure he hopped over the 🌈bridge very happy.

What lovely, skilled staff. Unfortunately, we had to have our cat put to sleep; they were very compassionate and clear with the information. We were allowed to take all the time we needed for the farewell. Thank you so much for everything!

Allison (I think her name was) was an extremely kind, sensitive, and sympathetic vet. She was very mindful of space and time needed to care for our cat when he got put down. Truly thankful for the care she put in. Thank you so much <3
Very nice people with a great service.
The best vet you will find in Amsterdam. They are empathetic and helpful, and have never let any of my cats down.

Our cat Dirkie came today and he was thoroughly checked and given a clear explanation. We are truly delighted with your service. I contacted you twice by phone because I couldn't make it, but they still listened lovingly and offered helpful tips. A perfect 10 from us. Thank you.

We were very grateful to find this vet when we needed tapeworm treatment and the necessary paperwork for bringing our dog back to the UK after our vacation. It was difficult to find a vet with availability after New Year’s, but thankfully they had space and were able to help.

Our dog also cut his paw just before our visit, and the vet gave him a check-up and provided helpful advice on how to care for the injury. Their calm and professional approach made the experience straightforward and stress-free.

We appreciated their efficiency and care during a busy time of year. If you’re travelling with your pet, this vet is a reliable choice. Thank you for your help!
All the staff here have always been great over the years and our new vet has been amazing. It is a lovely little spot, even my dog likes going haha

To be honest, I was a bit scared to go after reading some bad reviews, but for me, it was truly worth 5 stars!
All the people were very friendly; the vet explained everything very well and gave me several options.
When picking up the cat, everything was explained to me clearly, and they really took their time with us.
It is a bit more expensive than my own vet (who was fully booked), but they are located right in the city center.
In the end, my cat is completely recovered and happy. And so am I!

Helped my Luna in an emergency. The vet talked us through our options and did not try to push any decisions on us. The receptionist even came out to help us find the place, when construction made it hard to find! They really earned our trust.

fast help for my dog ben after a small accident.
very kind and -due to the dierendokters' 🕷🕸decoration for upcoming halloween - even combined with fun.
best medicine for the owner of the patient.
a HUGE thank you to all of you 🙏🧡🐶🧡🙏

I've been a client of DierenDokters for about three or four years and am very satisfied with their services.

My cat recently had to be admitted for emergency care, and he was cared for and transferred there in an excellent manner.

What I particularly appreciate is the clear and thorough consultation that always takes place.
You really feel that your pet is being cared for with attention and care.

I feel I have to leave a review
I have been going to this veterinary clinic for at least 8 years.
Super sweet assistants and doctors
Woezel has received excellent care these past 8 years.
We had to have Woezel put to sleep on September 26th; it was done very respectfully at home.
Thank you.
At DierenDokters is always nice and friendly atmosphere! My cats are more relaxed than at any other vet I was before. Reaction times are very fast and help is always professional!
I am very satisfied; always a friendly greeting, and the assistants are particularly friendly and helpful—nice people and a decent price—plus, very importantly, sweet to my dog ​​Droppie.

Attentive, caring, experienced.

Nice waiting room with a great coffee machine. Food and medicine available for your pet.
Constantly miss diagnosed my dog to the point of costing him his eyes. Extremely unreliable veterinaries, never helped.
Cannot recommend enough, they care so much about your pet!

Antisocial company, not concerned with animal care.
Purely focused on money.
Very unfriendly staff. Products are shoved down your throat. No real care is …
